parsed.rationale: The second participating record lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path — a canonical sample-app location that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The canonical production initializer resides in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift' (package: DebugPanel), while the duplicate in DebugHUD.swift is a demonstration-context copy. Merging these would couple the DebugPanel production package to sample-app semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. The correct resolution, if the sample-app copy is redundant, is to delete it from the sample app — not to extract shared code.
